So I am camping at various places in British Columbia and decide to head over to Sasquatch Provincial Park after I got bored with Golden Ears Park, and I wind up getting trapped inside the park due to a land slide and wash out of the only road in or out. 



I just have barely enough of a data connection to upload this video. Hopefully I am out of here within a few days. I am awaiting an update from the Emergency Services.
